platforms.name: Unix
platforms.description: Linux, BSD and other Unix systems: the connection account changes its own password with passwd, root included.

platforms.name: macOS
platforms.description: The connection account changes its own password with sysadminctl, which also changes that of its login keychain, if it has one. Tested on macOS 15.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.description: Windows OpenSSH with cmd.exe as the default shell. The account must be a local administrator.
